The '''Corellian compound bow''' was a large [[Bow/Legends|bow]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. With a typical draw weight of fifty-five to eighty-five [[kilogram]]s, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] bows came equipped with a system of cams and cables to lever the arms and reduce the draw weight, allowing for longer, more accurate aiming when fully drawn. The impressive tension stored in a Corellian compound bow allowed it to fire broadhead [[arrow]]s with a tremendous amount of kinetic force. The bow could fire [[Explosive tipped arrow|explosive tipped]] or [[stun arrow]]s as well. As any bow with a draw weight of less than fifty kilograms was often considered a [[Youngling/Legends|children's]] model, some Corellians considered drawing a compound bow a true test of a [[Gender/Legends|man's]] strength. Made of composite materials, the bow could fire up to a medium distance and sold for 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="Suns of Fortune" /> after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="EotE date">The [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] establishes that ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' takes place after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an event that occurred during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], dated by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian compound bow was mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook for ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]<ref name="Suns of Fortune" /> in [[2014]].<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref>
